items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Albert Walter will tell you the same thing I don't know if you remember.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you remember you hear about the old dances too where they'd hire two bands like some of the society people maybe for a party I've heard of that. They have two bands there and they both play a few numbers and then they'll send one of them home pretty soon.

What band they like the best. What band the people likes the best they keep. Did they do that quite often they think? Well a lot of times it had been done. And then one time ago maybe Albert Walter will tell you the same thing I don't know if you remember. Every Monday we had things they call a banquet.
